title: "Biographical information"

```{r}
setup_path <- if (file.exists("R/setup.R")) "R/setup.R" else "../R/setup.R"
source(setup_path)
```

Age, gender, and migration background for the `r survey$n` young people who agreed to take part. `r survey$n_declined` people in `r survey$file` declined and are not included on this page.

## Gender

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
show_dist(survey, "gender1", title = "What gender do you identify as?")
```

## Gender identity

This question is asked only when the answer to gender is "Other gender identity".

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
show_dist(survey, "ident1", among_asked = TRUE, title = "What do you identify as?")
```

## Grade

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5.6
show_dist(survey, "grade1", title = "What grade are you in?")
```

## Age

Age is completed years on 1 July 2026. The file has no interview date. A birthday in July is counted as already reached, because the day of the month is unknown. A birthday in August or later is still ahead. Mean age is `r sprintf("%.1f", mean(survey$age, na.rm = TRUE))` years (`r sum(!is.na(survey$age))` young people). Age is missing for `r sum(is.na(survey$age))` because the birth year or birth month is blank.

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
age_label <- ifelse(is.na(survey$age), NA_character_, as.character(survey$age))
age_levels <- as.character(sort(unique(survey$age[!is.na(survey$age)])))
show_vector(age_label, "Age on 1 July 2026", age_levels)
```

## Migration background

Born in `r survey$country` means the birthplace answer is `r survey$country`. The survey country is taken from the question about age at moving to `r survey$country`. Young people born in `r survey$country` whose parent birthplaces are not both known, and who do not have a parent born abroad, are kept in their own row so they are not counted as either "both parents born in `r survey$country`" or "one or both parents born abroad".

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7
mig_levels <- c(
  paste0("Born in ", survey$country, ", both parents born in ", survey$country),
  paste0("Born in ", survey$country, ", one or both parents born abroad"),
  "Born abroad",
  paste0("Born in ", survey$country, ", parent birthplace incomplete")
)
show_vector(survey$migration, "Migration background", mig_levels)
```

## Country of birth

Countries with no respondents are left off this list. Everyone who gave a country is listed.

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
show_dist(survey, "bplace1", title = "Where were you born?")
```
